meta_description: Plumb Plus (Dave the Plumber) is your trusted emergency plumber in Middlesbrough. Fast response, honest pricing, no call-out charge. Call 07956 572412.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Middlesbrough? Dave arrives fast, fixes it right, and keeps costs fair.
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to routine maintenance, Dave handles every job with the same care and attention.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast, day or night. We attend most emergency calls within the hour and carry parts to fix jobs on the spot.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Installation
services.desc: Expert diagnosis and repair of broken boilers, plus full installation of new systems with warranty. Keep your home warm without the stress.

services.title: Central Heating
services.desc: System flushing, radiator installation, pump repairs, and bleeding. We ensure your heating runs efficiently and reliably through winter.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Tap installation, sink replacement, and full bathroom pipework. We work around your schedule and leave your space clean and tidy.

services.title: Pipe Repairs & Replacement
services.desc: Frozen pipes, corroded copper, or leaking joints — we locate the problem and fix it properly, with no shortcuts or bodges.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Clearance
services.desc: Blocked drains cleared fast using high-pressure jetting and manual tools. We clear the blockage and identify the root cause to prevent it happening again.

about_pullquote: I started Dave the Plumber because I got tired of seeing locals ripped off.
about_para_1: Dave set up Plumb Plus nearly two decades ago after too many years watching neighbours get fleeced by cowboy plumbers. What started as one van and a handshake has grown into a trusted name across Middlesbrough, built entirely on honest work and fair pricing. Every job — whether an emergency at 2am or a routine boiler service — gets the same level of care and expertise.
about_para_2: Customers keep calling back because Dave turns up when he says he will, explains what's wrong in plain English, and quotes a fair price before touching your pipes. He's not interested in upselling or cutting corners. Middlesbrough homeowners trust him because he's been here 18 years and he treats every job like it's his own home.
reviews_heading: What Middlesbrough Homeowners Say About Plumb Plus

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe under the kitchen at 11pm on a Saturday. Called Dave and he was here by midnight. Fixed it straightaway, didn't charge an arm and a leg, and even cleaned up after himself. Brilliant service. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in during the cold snap. Dave came out the same morning, diagnosed a faulty valve, and had us back on heat by early afternoon. No hidden charges, no faffing about. What you're quoted is what you pay. Top bloke.
reviews.author: Jennifer P.

reviews.text: New radiators fitted in the bathroom and bedroom. Dave was professional, tidy, and finished on time. He explained everything clearly and didn't rush the job. Been recommending him to all our mates.
reviews.author: Robert C.
